why: Site activity, two kinds of document in one container partitioned on the UTC day: one per store per hour for the graph, one per visitor token per store per day for the table behind the operator's key. Every write is a partial update that increments counters in place, so two containers adding to the same hour add rather than overwrite. The day, the kind, the store and the hour are indexed because the Admin tab queries a window of days by kind; nothing else is. Documents do not expire: they were given thirty-five days at first, and on 13 September Steve asked for the site's activity to be kept long term, so time-to-live stays enabled on the container with no default, which is the value that keeps everything (ADR: Site activity, and the line an address does not cross, third addendum).
